title: Norwegian Pork Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring Norwegian pork, served with lively vegetables.
instructions: Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Add the sliced carrots to the skillet and cook for an additional 4 minutes.
Add the chopped potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, or until they begin to tenderize.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
